judge_reasoning: The model's solution attempts to activate Mirage Mirror's own 'becomes a copy' ability sequentially after Mirror has already become a copy of Multiform Wonder. Once Mirror copies another permanent, it loses its own printed abilities (including the copy-ability itself) unless the copied permanent also has that ability, which Multiform Wonder does not. The official solution specifically works around this by activating the copy ability twice on the stack while Mirror is still 'Mirage Mirror' before either resolves, then using the Wonder-granted flying ability in between resolutions - precisely to avoid the illegal action the model performs. The model's sequential execution (resolve Wonder-copy, then try to reactivate the copy ability) is not rules-legal, so it fails to produce a 10/10 flying Colossus copy, and the remaining attackers cannot guarantee lethal damage against the opponent's blockers.
model_solution:
1. Tap 4 lands and cast Hedron Archive.
2. Cast Metalwork Colossus for {0} (noncreature artifacts: Bomat Bazaar Barge 4 + Mirage Mirror 3 + Hedron Archive 4 = 11 = full reduction).
3. Tap Hedron Archive for {C}{C} and the last 2 lands (4 mana available).
4. Pay {2}: Mirage Mirror becomes a copy of Multiform Wonder until end of turn.
5. Pay your 1 energy to Mirror's (Multiform Wonder) ability: Mirror gains flying until end of turn.
6. Pay {2}: Mirage Mirror becomes a copy of Metalwork Colossus until end of turn. It is now a 10/10 artifact creature that still has flying (the ability-granting effect from step 5 applies in layer 6, above the copy effect in layer 1, so it persists).
7. Go to combat and attack with the Mirror (10/10 flying Metalwork Colossus). It has been under your control since the start of the turn, so it isn't summoning sick. (You may also attack with Multiform Wonder and Bomat Bazaar Barge crewed by the real Colossus, but it isn't needed.)
8. The opponent's Hollow Ones and Chaos Maw have neither flying nor reach, so the Mirror cannot be blocked. It deals 10 damage – exactly lethal against 10 life.
